US warns citizens to leave Iran amid regional tensions

The U.S. Virtual Embassy in Iran issued a security alert warning U.S. citizens against traveling to the country and urging them to leave immediately. The alert cited a complex regional security environment and potential travel disruptions, including flight cancellations and airspace closures. Iran, in turn, warned against new escalation by the U.S. and its allies.
